protocol.default: native interpolation/support is unchanged; all new behavior is explicit opt-in
protocol.phase_mode_observations: Original direct predictor on actual observation union each proposal, bypasses unused support setup; original dynamic JD/phase conversion, reducers/order/repeats, support-mean l3, maximum then observation-mean normalization and noise law retained
protocol.resolution_check: Original CPU target12deg +8deg +6deg on independently copied Observers, both target-to-finest and middle-to-finest joint D<=0.1; check fresh each candidate, then requested CPU/hybrid target evaluated
protocol.noise_budget: Original normalized observational y_err, independent of fitted ln_f. Actual posterior retains original sigma²*(1+exp(2ln_f)).
protocol.failure_policy: Resolution/reference failure aborts outside original catch-all LSQ/MCMC handlers even emergencyTrue; never physical-prior cut, invalid-model diagnostic or same-grid CPU fallback. Actual original target/preparation failures retain original rejection policy. Prior exclusions do no synthesis.
protocol.reference_domain: Exactly two finer decreasing CPU grids >=3deg; finite empirical comparison, not continuum certificate or monotonicity assumption
protocol.unsupported_device: Original complete CPU target fallback, preserving finite posterior when valid. Fallback cannot repair shared mesh error.
protocol.runtime: Single caller/serial synthesis/LSQ/MCMC; no global CPU patch/backend registration, default change, physical cache or retained accuracy certificate

scientific_assessment.high_precision: Known1e-4 fixture fails the explicit budget in CPU and hybrid LSQ/MCMC before GPU synthesis; this is a controlled accuracy stop, not an implementation-parity failure.
scientific_assessment.positive_control: Separate assigned sigma0.05 with matching independent seeded Gaussian synthetic noise909; not a relaxed1e-4 criterion. All selected candidate finite checks pass. Weak fit hits the T6000K lower bound; no parameter recovery claim.
scientific_assessment.inference: Original public16-evaluation two-point/diff_step1e-4 two-parameter LSQ and8walkers/3steps sampler replay; no changes to priors, bounds, serializers or move implementations. No convergence, ESS/sec, calibrated uncertainty, domain-wide certificate or continuum posterior claim.
scientific_assessment.accuracy_budget: D0.1 corresponds to expected loss0.005 for data generated by finite reference; it does not bound the realized residual cross-term or omitted physics.
scientific_assessment.remaining: Finer/adaptive surface convergence at1e-4, including contacts/reflection; finite exposure, missing spectral/model systematics and longer-chain convergence remain separate

timing_conditions.matched: Sequential CPU-forced then GPU driver inside window017, same affinity0-15/Nice10/threads1/FP64 and complete host output contracts; three warm changed-vector samples.
timing_conditions.callbacks: Complete original parameter/prior/likelihood work, fresh physical curves, all CPU references when enabled, CPU bridges, device dispatch and all transfers. Setup is separate; first per-instance callback includes compilation incurred but process code caches can already be warm.
timing_conditions.fits: Constructor plus public fit() includes setup, compilation incurred, qualification/callbacks, original optimization/sampler and serialization. Auxiliary dataset generation, option copying, post-fit diagnostic prediction/parity and result-list conversions are outside fitter subtimers but included in complete driver wall time.
timing_conditions.qualification: CPU target and both refinements plus requested target always charged; CPU target is currently deliberately repeated, not reused to claim an acceleration.
timing_conditions.development: Cores16-19/Nice19 CPU development while production runs is correctness evidence only, excluded from matched measurements.
timing_conditions.limits: Small sample counts and short replay do not establish general throughput or ESS/sec; fine-grid fallback and accuracy failures are disclosed
